description.short_caption: Discoloration and cyanosis of the fingers on both hands.
description.detailed_description: This image shows both hands of a patient with marked discoloration of the fingers, appearing darkened and cyanotic. The discoloration is most prominent on the distal phalanges. The patient is wearing a hospital gown, and an intravenous line is visible in the right hand, suggesting a clinical setting. The findings may indicate peripheral ischemia or severe hypoxemia.

description.short_caption: Discoloration and necrosis of fingers, suggestive of ischemia or severe infection.
description.detailed_description: The image shows a hand with significant discoloration of the fingers, particularly darkened areas at the tips, suggestive of necrosis. The skin appears dry and mottled, with a bluish-black hue on the distal phalanges. The surrounding tissue shows mild swelling, and there is no visible active bleeding or exudate. A gloved hand is partially visible, indicating a clinical setting.

description.short_caption: MRI of the brain showing multiple hyperintense lesions in the white matter.
description.detailed_description: This axial T2-weighted MRI image of the brain shows multiple hyperintense lesions in the white matter, predominantly in the frontal lobes. The lesions are bilateral and appear well-defined, suggesting a demyelinating or infectious process. The surrounding brain parenchyma appears normal, with no significant mass effect or midline shift. The image orientation and labeling indicate standard MRI conventions.
visible_findings: multiple hyperintense lesions in the white matter
bilateral distribution, predominantly in the frontal lobes
no significant mass effect or midline shift

description.short_caption: Bilateral hand findings with black discoloration and desquamation.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows both hands with significant black discoloration of the distal fingers, suggestive of necrosis. There is also peeling and desquamation of the skin on the palms and fingers. The findings are symmetric and involve multiple digits. The background includes clothing, indicating a clinical setting.
visible_findings: desquamation of skin on palms and fingers

description.short_caption: Bilateral hand necrosis with black discoloration and tissue loss.
description.detailed_description: This image shows both hands of a patient with extensive black discoloration of the fingers, consistent with necrosis. The necrotic changes are more pronounced on the distal phalanges, with some areas showing tissue loss and exposure of underlying structures. The skin appears dry and desiccated, with a sharp demarcation between affected and unaffected areas. The changes are symmetrical, involving both hands.
visible_findings: sharp demarcation between necrotic and viable tissue
